args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%) compared to distributed processing.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, making fast turnaround the key lever for profitability.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns and its companion piece at https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion
